Canonical boxing classifies the actual carrier rather than stamping an Object tag from source annotation; nullable ABI controls are included.
documentation: Replace the obsolete incoming deep-copy proposal with the normative live-reference contract and explicit physical ABI obligations; this is not an implementation/completion claim.
